admission.justification: A retained page that cannot be reopened without a model, or that silently adopts a new comparison, defeats the durability the developer asked for.

applicability: Every retained explanation revision and every staleness answer the review page shows.
conditions: A part id satisfies the shared part-id grammar and is not the reserved whole-page id.
A claim belongs to one part and every claim of the revision belongs to a part.
Staleness is computed per basis, so a part is stale when one of its claims' bases moved.
exclusions: A revision stored before part maps, which is answered whole-page.
The store's own FrameStaleness, which remains the whole-page answer and names the changed sides.

evidence: A5-verdict.md; A5-fixed-list-verification.md; A5-checks-complete/; prior A4 full-criterion account retained

statement: A retained revision carries the part map readiness admitted for it, and a staleness answer names each stale part with the reason its claim bases moved, falling back to the whole page when a revision holds no usable part map or holds a stale claim no part admits; a revision's bounds are bytes per revision and bytes per task, the lineage and revision-count ceilings are gone, and a retained revision leaves the store only through the developer's removal control.
